about.title: CREATIVE VISION.
about.description:
Hi, I'm Ahmed. I am a multidisciplinary creative specializing in high-end graphic design, cinematic video editing, and motion graphics. With years of experience pushing pixels and crafting narratives, my goal is simple: to transform raw ideas into striking visual realities.

Whether I'm developing a robust brand identity from scratch or editing a fast-paced commercial reel, I obsess over the micro-details that separate good design from unforgettable design.

services.title: BRAND IDENTITY
services.desc: Crafting comprehensive, scalable visual systems. From iconic logo marks to typography and full brand guidelines that ensure your business stands out.

services.title: VIDEO EDITING
services.desc: Cinematic storytelling tailored for high retention. Commercials, documentaries, and social reels cut with precision, perfect pacing, and advanced color grading.

services.title: MOTION GRAPHICS
services.desc: Breathing life into static designs. Kinetic typography, 3D product visualizations, and dynamic UI animations that capture and hold audience attention.
